text:
My eyes strengthened this gentle river's current; singing checked its course: so much can grief do in one absent!


I saw myself aflame in this fountain before ice seized it, and saw my face would not stain your brow's gold.


Incense covered your altars, crowned with grain; I dried and swelled Henares with tears and fire.


Today pain and anger force me to see two seas in one stream when I behold my eyes.

translation.title: My Eyes Strengthened the Current...
